prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one new 16:9 anime visual novel ending frame, a companion to the supplied reference illustration.
Reference role: identity, art style, towel, bedroom and lighting continuity. Preserve the same adult Miku (around thirty, married), long copper-brown hair with side fringe, blue eyes and gentle mature face.
Change: she is now lying comfortably on her side across the bed, her head resting on a soft pillow, one hand relaxed near her cheek on the pillow, the other on the bed in front of her. Legs together and naturally slightly bent, relaxed everyday resting posture. She looks toward her husband outside the frame with a small affectionate, expectant smile, as if waiting for him to come back and talk before sleep.
Her thick opaque ivory bath towel remains securely wrapped high across the chest and extends below the knees, closed and with ample comfortable fabric. No removal or slipping. Natural folds.
Composition: medium-wide view from the husband's perspective beside the bed, face and gentle expression as the focal point, with her relaxed reclining pose clearly readable. Only Miku appears. Preserve the wooden headboard, cream bed linen, warm bedside lamp, blue curtains and cool night window of the reference. Warm romantic domestic mood, clean anime lines and soft detailed shading.
Avoid sexual posing, arched back, body-part emphasis, revealing angles, nudity, sexual props, text, logos or collage. A quiet tender nonsexual scene.
